eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CIVIL DANGER WARNING for the following counties or areas: Olmsted, MN; at 6:11 PM on AUG 29, 2024 Effective until 7:11 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A message from Rochester Emergency Management. Authorities are on the scene of a hazardous materials release on the highway in the vicinity of Interstate 90 and Highway 52. Stay away from the area and remain upwind to avoid possible exposure. Again, avoid this area and remain upwind.
